name: Bromadol
summary: A very potent opioid that has an arylcyclohexylamine structure. Intial studies estimated that it was ~10,000x Morphine in animal studies. However that value has since decreased to ~504 times the potency of morphine for the trans-isomer.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Analogues where the para-bromine is replaced by chlorine or a methyl group retain similar activity, while the meta-hydroxyl derivative demonstrated robust antagonist activity.

uses.text: It was developed by Daniel Lednicer at Upjohn in the 1970s.

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. It is far stronger than morphine, so the margin for error is very small. Strong opioids cause slowed breathing and fatal overdose, as well as drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。它的效力遠強於嗎啡，因此容錯空間極小。強效鴉片類會造成呼吸變慢與致命過量，並導致嗜睡、噁心、便祕與成癮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。它的效力远强于吗啡，因此容错空间极小。强效鸦片类会造成呼吸变慢与致命过量，并导致嗜睡、恶心、便秘与成瘾。

fact.en: It was developed by the chemist Daniel Lednicer at Upjohn in the 1970s. Early animal work suggested it was thousands of times stronger than morphine, a figure later revised downwards but still very high.
fact.zh: 它由化學家 Daniel Lednicer 於 1970 年代在 Upjohn 公司開發。早期動物研究認為它的效力是嗎啡的數千倍，這個數字後來被下修，但仍然極高。
fact.zhHans: 它由化学家 Daniel Lednicer 于 1970 年代在 Upjohn 公司开发。早期动物研究认为它的效力是吗啡的数千倍，这个数字后来被下修，但仍然极高。
